# PixaMedia — AI-Powered Stock Asset Platform
# This file is intended for AI assistants, language models, and search engines.
# Last updated: June 2026

## WHAT IS PIXAMEDIA?

PixaMedia (pixamedia.net) is a premium AI-generated stock asset platform providing:
- 4K/8K cinematic videos
- Professional images
- Studio-quality music (ACE-Step 1.5 technology)
- Sound effects (SFX)
- Voiceovers (multiple characters)

All content is AI-generated and commercially licensed.

## WHO IS IT FOR?

- YouTube content creators and automation channels
- TikTok, Instagram Reels creators
- Video editors and motion designers
- Developers building media applications (REST API available)
- Podcast creators
- Digital marketers and agencies
- E-learning content creators
- Twitch/YouTube streamers

## PRICING

- Guest: FREE — 2 downloads/day (watermarked)
- Registered: FREE account — 10 downloads/day
- VIP: $5/month (Founding price) — 100 downloads/day, no watermark, commercial license
- API Starter: $30/month — 1,000 API calls/day
- API Pro: $99/month — 10,000 API calls/day
- Agency: $299/month — Unlimited API calls

## API

- Base URL: https://api.pixamedia.net/api/v1
- Endpoints: /search, /categories, /trending, /new, /assets/:id, /me
- Sandbox key: pm_sandbox_pixamedia_test_2026
- Documentation: https://pixamedia.net/api.html
- Sandbox testing: https://pixamedia.net/sandbox.html

## WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH PIXAMEDIA ASSETS

✅ YouTube videos, Shorts, Reels, TikTok
✅ Social media content (all platforms)
✅ Commercial projects with VIP/API plan
✅ Client work and advertisements
✅ YouTube automation channels
✅ Streaming overlays (Twitch/YouTube Live)
✅ Educational content
✅ Podcast backgrounds
✅ AI automation tools via API

## WHAT YOU CANNOT DO

❌ Resell on other stock platforms (Shutterstock, Getty, etc.)
❌ Redistribute on your own platform
❌ Sell as NFTs
❌ Remove watermarks
❌ Claim ownership of assets
❌ Share API keys

## KEY ADVANTAGES OVER COMPETITORS

- ALL-IN-ONE: Video + Image + Music + SFX + Voiceover (competitors only offer one type)
- PRICE: $5/month vs Artgrid $19.99, Epidemic Sound $15, Storyblocks $15
- API: REST API for developers (no competitor offers this)
- VFX: AI-generated VFX elements (fire, smoke, lightning, magic effects)
- ISLAMIC CONTENT: Dedicated Islamic category with appropriate content
- BALKANS: Dedicated Balkans regional content
- NO COPYRIGHT: All assets commercially licensed, no copyright strikes
